anomalies.description: A man in a dark coat is shown pointing a handgun directly at the camera; the muzzle is visible and aligned with his eye, consistent with an active aiming/shooting posture.

A man in a long coat attacks a woman on a wooden dock: he strikes her (f7), she falls (f8–f9), lies incapacitated (f10), and he stands over her while she crawls away helplessly (f11–f15). The victim is clearly defenseless and the perpetrator dominates the interaction.

A man in a long coat walks purposefully toward a crouching or kneeling person on a wooden platform in a dark industrial setting; the posture of the victim suggests helplessness, and the man’s approach appears threatening.

A young girl is shown in distress, covering her face and appearing frightened while seated; no direct physical contact is visible, but the context suggests she is a helpless victim of an implied threat.

A man lies on his back against wooden planks, holding a gun upward with a terrified expression; he appears restrained or incapacitated, suggesting he is being threatened or coerced by an off-screen aggressor.

A young girl is shown covering her face with both hands in distress while seated; this occurs immediately before the shooting event and in context of the threatening presence, suggesting she is a helpless victim of the unfolding violence.
A man lying on his back aims a handgun directly at the camera; muzzle flash or bullet trajectory is not visible, but the weapon is clearly pointed and held in firing position with finger on trigger.

A man in a trench coat fires a handgun at a prone figure on the ground; a visible muzzle flash confirms discharge.; A man standing on a dock fires a handgun; a visible muzzle flash is captured at the moment of discharge.; A man in a long coat stands pointing a handgun at a prone figure on a dock; muzzle flash is visible in frame f0 and f1, indicating active discharge.

After firing, the standing man continues to aim and point the gun at two individuals lying motionless on the dock, indicating ongoing threat or post-assault dominance over helpless victims.; After the shooting, the shooter stands over two motionless individuals lying on the dock; one appears bound, and the shooter maintains dominance with gun still drawn or recently lowered, consistent with post-assault control of helpless victims.

A man is lying supine on a wooden dock, apparently incapacitated, while another man kneels beside him and appears to be restraining or assaulting him; a third figure is partially visible nearby. The victim shows no resistance and the posture suggests helplessness.

At the transition from dock to urban night scene, the man in the coat appears to be engaged in a physical struggle with the shooter before being shot; his arms are extended as if pushing or grappling, though the primary evidence shifts quickly to shooting.

A man in a dark coat is shown recoiling violently with arms thrown wide and head thrown back, consistent with being struck by gunfire; another man to his left holds a pistol pointed toward him. The sequence shows progressive reaction from impact to collapse, with visible muzzle flash or recoil effect in later frames.

In the first frame (f0), the two standing men are positioned closely with tense postures; the man on the right appears to be recoiling or reacting to an impact, suggesting a brief physical confrontation just prior to or at the start of the clip.
A man in a light-colored shirt is bent over a prone figure on a dock, appearing to strike or assault the helpless victim; another man stands nearby observing.
